newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Acceptance Group names president.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Acceptance Group names president.

text.p: Reliance Acceptance Group Inc said on Tuesday that Jack Plunkitt has been named as president and chief operating officer of the company and of its Reliance Acceptance Corp operating subsidiary.
Plunkitt succeeds Thoman Barlow, who resigned as president last month as a result of finacial setbacks at the company.
Plunkitt most recently served as senior vice president of Money Store Auto Finance Inc, where he was responsible for all operations.

"The hiring of Mr. Plunkitt is a key element in our plan to return to profitability," said Howard Silverman, chairman and chief executive of Reliance Acceptance, a consumer finance company specializing in used-car sales.

Last month, Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co cut its rating of the company to single-B-minus, a move it attributed in part to exceptions to underwriting policy, inadequate internal controls and "lack of management depth."
